title: data.pdf — section 72
text:
(7) In this regulation—
“appropriate date” means the later of the date on which it was signed by the person issuing it
or the date indicated by him as being the date before which it shall not be supplied;
“healthcare professional” has the same meaning as in the National Health Service Act 1977;
“patient” means the person named in the prescription as the person to whom the drug is to
be supplied;
“patient’s representative” means a person sent by or on behalf of the patient (other than a
healthcare representative acting in his professional capacity).]
